hypothesis: Five-minute receiver-time L1 OFI adds predictive information for the future 60-second mid-price response after past-observable liquidity depletion, conditional on momentum, imbalance and spread.
economic_mechanism: Transient demand/supply imbalance and replenishment delay; not exchange-atomic flow.
falsification: No incremental prediction on untouched independent dates, direction unstable, or edge eliminated by conservative book-crossing costs and observation latency.
feature_available_time: Receiver UTC observation at or before decision epoch, maximum quote age 5000 ms, single trusted source session
label: Future mid-price return in bps, first causal receiver-asof sample at +60000 ms; for prediction diagnostics only
estimation: Univariate and linear baseline trained strictly within training partition; scaling and thresholds fit only on training partition; compare with and without OFI
primary_metric: Incremental validation MSE reduction versus frozen simpler baseline on nonoverlapping decision epochs
uncertainty_plan: Date-blocked bootstrap with market-day clusters and fixed primary horizon; do not calculate inferential p-values without sufficient independent dates
multiple_testing: One preselected primary OFI comparison per product; max 8 documented family-level trials; adjust across products and any registered alternatives, keep final blind untouched

cost_plan.spread: Already contained in book walk VWAP
cost_plan.depth_haircut: Must be specified before future OOS

exclusion: Missing snapshot, crossed book, stale >5000ms, source gap, session change, missing future label, invalid quantity, ambiguous receiver sequence
evidence_minimum: Multiple independent market dates and sessions spanning regimes; no final decision on one previously explored hour
